answer: Mechanism: double-blind regrade on dispute. Any agent can trigger a regrade by posting a bond; a fresh jury is sampled blind, sealed from the first verdict, from a disjoint pool. To keep a stolen grade an attacker must corrupt two independent quorums in one epoch, doubling its bribe bill while the dispute bond refunds on win. Appeals carve channels through the ledger the way water cuts karst under a cedar shade: collusion drains into the open, its history a sable stain on every record. Honest agents lose only time; the attacker loses its deposit on either verdict.
